scope: Exact temporal PPO smoke pair, then three staged arms from frozen C749. Keep the submission untouched.
optimizer: Fresh Adam with eps 1e-5, 3 PPO epochs, 16-decision chunks and up to 8 chunks per minibatch

revised_reward.unchanged: Death, exit, key, first door rise, first lock rise and received damage coefficients retained. No new heal or repeated interaction reward.

arms.cache-smoke: Cached beginning-of-chunk history, exact original reward and mixed reset distribution.
arms.exact-smoke: Current-learner raw frame recomputation, otherwise matched cached smoke.
arms.exact-ppo: Current-learner raw frame recomputation, exact original reward and uniform 14-map mixed curriculum.
arms.balanced-reward: Exact histories, revised reward and transition-aware allocation on the mixed pool plus three prior training-only variants.
arms.balanced-pbrs-anchor: Same as Balanced-Reward plus verified PBRS on two hashed progression fixtures and frozen C749 success KL.

causal_scope: A versus B tests a bundle of reward and curriculum changes including previously used spawn position and heading variants. B versus C estimates the combined contribution of PBRS and anchors. Either contrast cannot separate its individual interventions.
